\section{Inline text features}
Escapes: 100\% of \$5 \& more, file\_name, \#tag, \{braces\}.
Dashes: a---b, range 1--10. Quotes: ``quoted'' text. Ellipsis \ldots
Styles: \textbf{bold}, \textit{italic}, \emph{emph}, \texttt{mono}, \underline{under}.
Nested: \textbf{bold with \textit{italic} inside}.
% this comment must vanish
Non-breaking~space and a reference \ref{eq:main} plus \cite{knuth}.

\section{Display math variants}
Bracket form:
\[
  E = mc^{2}
\]

Dollar form:
$$
\nabla \cdot \mathbf{E} = \frac{\rho}{\varepsilon_{0}}
$$

Aligned system:
\begin{align*}
  \dot{x} &= \sigma (y - x) \\
  \dot{y} &= x (\rho - z) - y \\
  \dot{z} &= x y - \beta z
\end{align*}

Gathered:
\begin{gather*}
  a^{2} + b^{2} = c^{2} \\
  \sin^{2}{\theta} + \cos^{2}{\theta} = 1
\end{gather*}

\section{Structures}
Nested fractions and radicals:
\begin{equation}
  \varphi = \frac{1 + \sqrt{5}}{2}, \qquad
  x = \sqrt[3]{\frac{a + \sqrt{b}}{c - \sqrt[4]{d}}}
\end{equation}

Deep delimiters:
\begin{equation}
  f = \left[ \frac{\left( a + \left\{ b \right\} \right)}{\left| c \right|} \right]^{n}
\end{equation}

Binomials and stacked scripts:
\begin{equation}
  (x + y)^{n} = \sum_{k=0}^{n}{\binom{n}{k} x^{k} y^{n-k}}
\end{equation}

Matrices:
\begin{equation}
  A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \end{bmatrix}, \quad
  \det \begin{vmatrix} a & b \\ c & d \end{vmatrix} = ad - bc
\end{equation}

Over/under constructs:
\begin{equation}
  \overline{z_{1} z_{2}} = \overline{z_{1}} \cdot \overline{z_{2}}, \quad
  \underbrace{a + \cdots + a}_{n \text{ times}} = na
\end{equation}

Evaluation bar and multi-integral:
\begin{equation}
  \left. F(x) \right|_{a}^{b} = \iiint_{V}{\nabla \cdot \mathbf{F} \, dV}
\end{equation}

Operators and relations:
\begin{equation}
  \operatorname{rank}(A) \leq \min{\{ m, n \}}, \qquad
  a \equiv b \pmod{n}
\end{equation}

Limits both sides:
\begin{equation}
  \limsup_{n \to \infty}{x_{n}} \geq \liminf_{n \to \infty}{x_{n}}
\end{equation}

Primes and derivatives:
\begin{equation}
  f''(x) = \frac{d^{2} f}{d x^{2}}, \qquad
  \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial t^{2}} = c^{2} \nabla^{2} u
\end{equation}

\section{Lists}
\begin{itemize}
  \item First item with inline math $\alpha + \beta$.
  \item Second item.
\end{itemize}

\begin{enumerate}
  \item Numbered one.
  \item Numbered two with display math:
  \begin{equation*}
    \int_{0}^{1}{x^{2} dx} = \frac{1}{3}
  \end{equation*}
\end{enumerate}

\section{Edge cases}
Empty-ish math $x$ and a lone symbol $\emptyset$.
Greek soup: $\Gamma, \Delta, \Theta, \Lambda, \Xi, \Pi, \Sigma, \Upsilon, \Phi, \Psi, \Omega$.
Arrows: $\rightarrow \Rightarrow \leftrightarrow \mapsto \hookrightarrow$.
Sets: $\mathbb{N} \subseteq \mathbb{Z} \subset \mathbb{Q} \subset \mathbb{R} \subset \mathbb{C}$.
Logic: $\forall x \exists y : P(x) \wedge Q(y) \vee \neg R$.
